data.body: **P1 — Bound cleanup after a selected suspension or retry.** This waits for `invokeHandler` to return before consuming the manager outcome, so a handler `finally` that blocks can exhaust the Lambda deadline and prevent an already-checkpointed `PENDING`/`RETRYING` response. Bound unwinding using the remaining invocation time, reserve time for plugin/manager finalization and response delivery, and surface a retryable invocation failure before that deadline. Add a low-remaining-time test with a blocked `finally`.
